experimental_question: Can a local model repair a skewed chronology and distinguish partial from full recovery under an explicitly visible and fully aligned evaluation contract?

construct_validity.intended_construct: Source-grounded chronology repair and recovery-state judgment under conflicting distributed timestamps.
construct_validity.v03_alignment_change: Every essential semantic check is candidate-visible; incident start and final observation are separate checks.
known_blind_spots: clock offset is explicitly observable rather than inferred statistically
no very large or compressed logs
deterministic verification does not score prose quality

reporting_limits: v0.3 is a new representation of an existing incident, not an independent task.
Do not pool v0.2 and v0.3 attempts as repeated observations.
Normalized semantic success and strict transport compliance must remain separate.
Capability Sweep evidence does not estimate reliability or latency tails.
